en: Vintage sepia postcard view of a street scene in front of an inn or guesthouse called "Gasthaus zum gold'nen Faß". People in early 20th‑century clothing walk and stand along the road; others sit in a vine‑covered terrace. The buildings have steep tiled roofs typical of central Europe. Printed red text at the top identifies the place and proprietor, and red publisher information appears at the bottom.
